cards.title: Approaching the Foxtrot southern boundary
instructions: Switch to Foxtrot Common, UHF CH 22, for advisories and area coordination
Fly ~055° to remain clear of the lateral boundaries until de-conflicted
Avoid the North Mustang areas at all times
Minimum altitude over the Aransas Wildlife Refuge is 3,000 ft AGL
cards.source: Binder, p. 28; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 93 and 95.

cards.title: Climb or descend to {to.block} block
instructions: Climb or descend to your working altitude or a transition layer
Blocks may be subdivided by altitude; coordinate and de-conflict on Foxtrot Common
cards.source: Binder, pp. 26–28; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 94.
